description: Shared observable scenarios for the Rust-to-Go F2P batch BATCH-F2P-0003. Both the Rust source probes and the Go target probes consume these scenarios so the reference behavior and the migrated behavior are compared on identical inputs. Each scenario is a target-only postcondition: under the source technology (Rust 2021) the required target technology (Go 1.22) is not in effect, so the source side observes FAIL; the target side observes PASS.

scenarios.predicate: A revocation response with status 200 and a non-empty body returns a nil error; the body is ignored and is never deserialized as a token response.

scenarios.surface: oauth2/src/token/mod.rs::token type case-insensitive parsing and canonical serialization
scenarios.predicate: Unmarshalling {"access_token":"t","token_type":"BEARER"} into a BasicTokenResponse yields TokenTypeValue equal to BasicTokenTypeBearer ("bearer") and re-marshalling emits "token_type":"bearer".
Marshalling StandardErrorResponse{error:"invalid_grant", error_description:"bad", error_uri:"u"} yields a JSON object whose keys appear in the order error, error_description, error_uri.

scenarios.surface: oauth2/src/endpoint.rs::client credential placement in headers vs form body
scenarios.predicate: Given client id "a b" and secret "c:d" with BasicAuth, the emitted request has Authorization equal to "Basic " plus base64("a+b:c%3Ad"); raw concatenation is rejected.

scenarios.surface: oauth2/src/client.rs::revocation URL validation and missing-endpoint errors
scenarios.predicate: Building a revocation request against an http:// (non-HTTPS) URL returns ConfigurationError{Kind: ConfigurationInsecureURL} and the injected SyncHTTPClient's call count remains 0.
A token response with Content-Type "Application/JSON; charset=utf-8" is accepted, while "text/plain" returns an other error naming "text/plain".
Passing a SyncHTTPClientFunc to a flow request's Request method routes the call through the injected function and returns its HTTPResponse.
AddExtraParam(name, value) on a request type appends the supplied name/value to the outgoing request body.
The oauth2-reqwest crate, curl_client.rs, reqwest_client.rs, ureq_client.rs, wasm32/browser targets and client UI have no Go migration counterpart.
